scenarios.scenario: Insight — Inspect Distrib property across projects in signing build
scenarios.reasoning: The agent was efficient (4 tool calls, no errors) and correctly extracted the Distrib value for DataSources plus a genuine double-write finding. However it drew the wrong conclusion on the central question, explicitly ruling out shared output directories despite the tool warning it could not see inherited defaults, and it did no follow-up investigation to resolve that ambiguity. It also mismatched the signed directory with the actual failing command path. Plausible-sounding but misleading answer.

rubricScores.criterion: Found the Distrib property value for the DataSources project
Checked whether other projects (Common, StorageLibrary) use the same Distrib path
Identified that multiple projects point to the same shared output folder
Explained how the shared folder causes the signing conflict
